preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The maximum number of characters that can be removed is between 0 and the length of the string minus one.

postconditions.expression: all(s[i-1] == chr(ord(s[i]) - 1) or s[i+1] == chr(ord(s[i]) - 1) for i in range(1, len(s)-1) if i not in removed_indices) and (s[0] == chr(ord(s[1]) - 1) or 0 in removed_indices) and (s[-1] == chr(ord(s[-2]) - 1) or len(s) - 1 in removed_indices)
postconditions.description: Each removed character has at least one adjacent character that is the previous letter in the Latin alphabet, and the first and last characters are handled correctly if they are removed.
